title: KestrelCare Facility Agreement Schedule: Agreement Allowance on Repair Payments
content:
| Facility type on the decision | Agreement allowance taken from a KestrelCare repair payment |
|---|---|
| franchised dealer | 2 percent (the franchise agreement allowance) |
| independent licensed repair shop | 1 percent (the independent agreement allowance) |
| Kestrel network facility | none |

**Term.** A facility agreement allowance is taken from the amount of a KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts repair payment: a franchised dealer gives the franchise agreement allowance, an independent licensed repair shop the independent agreement allowance, and a Kestrel network facility none.

The allowance is taken by multiplying the amount by one less the allowance, before the payment is compared with the coverage remaining. The facility type is the one on the plan's approved claim decision entry being paid.

*Hypothetical:* on an amount of 2500.00, a franchised dealer is paid 2450.00, an independent licensed repair shop 2475.00 and a Kestrel network facility 2500.00.
